verdict.rationale: stagewise is a standalone desktop IDE for macOS, Windows and Linux. Its docs describe visual diff review: inline diffs with accept, reject and undo, plus a dedicated Diff Review page with a side-by-side view across modified files. The docs also say multiple agent instances can run in parallel, each with its own chat session and model. missing for 10: explicit evidence that parallel sessions can be laid out side by side in the UI, independent or hands-on corroboration of diff review and parallel sessions.
